messages:
Maria Park: FYI — quick vendor sync with Nvidia/AMD/Habana earlier. Short notes below, need decisions on announcement sequencing and contingency plan.

Alex Kim: TL;dr on supply? Which chips are at risk?

Maria Park: H200 inventory constrained in EMEA for July. H100 supply looks ok for dedicated pools through Sept. MI300 availability OK but delivery week jitter ±2 weeks. Gaudi delays from vendor X — new ETA mid-Aug.

Jonas Li: Can we map these to marketplace SKUs and launch windows? Need to avoid listing before capacity is secured.

Priya Singh: Agreed. I'll hold Marketplace PRs unless we can guarantee 95% capacity for first 30 days.

Ken O'Neal: We should prepare fallback routing: if H200 not available, route to H100@higher-cost or MI300 for fp16 workloads. Also flag customers for compatibility gaps.

Maria Park: Action items:
- @Priya: gate marketplace listing until capacity check (due: 2026-08-05)
- @Alex: confirm dedicated pool commits with Nvidia (due: 2026-07-28)
- @Jonas: update rollout timeline in ops doc

Alex Kim: pinging nvidia-liaison@vendor: "Confirming H200 commit for EU pool 50 nodes by 2026-08-01." They replied: "We can commit 40 nodes; 10 nodes delayed." (copied convo)

Priya Singh: Also legal note: export controls for MI300 variants — copying @Aisha Rahman to confirm statement for press.

calendarbot: added event 'Vendor Roadmap Sync — Contingency' on Tue Jul 30 10:00-10:30 PDT. Invite sent.

Maria Park: Can someone sketch a brief customer communication plan? Short bulletin + opt-in early access for customers on waiting list.

Jonas Li: I'll draft a 3-bullet customer message and share in #marketing-drafts by EOD.

Alex Kim: Also let's list fallback pricing impact: +15% token cost if routed to H100; +8% if MI300 used for fp16. I'll model.

Priya Singh: tagging @Aisha Rahman: need export wording. @Maria please add legal contact to the vendor thread.

Maria Park: Done. Added Aisha Rahman to the vendor thread. Thanks everyone. Closing loop after calendar sync. :thumbsup:
